newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent back above $23 as gas oil leads recovery.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent back above $23 as gas oil leads recovery.

text.p: IPE Brent futures climbed back above $23 a barrel, recovering some of Tuesday's earlier losses with gas oil futures again taking the lead.
Brent for November by 1440 GMT was down 17 cents on the day at $23.04 a barrel after slipping earlier to $22.67.
October gas oil was down 25 cents at $231.25, up $3.75 from its low of the day after an a technical test of support quickly ran out of steam.
"This gas oil market just refuses to lie down," said a broker.
Gas oil's premium over crude consolidated at higher levels of $6.75 a barrel and the Oct/Nov gas oil spread went out 75 cents to $10 a tonne.
Traders said gas oil, driven by low stocks and rising demand, again was looking to challenge a five-year high set in August 1991 of $235.
But dealers said signs of a technical barrier to further gains had prompted some hesitation in the market's bull run after last week's $1.50 gains on Brent.
Statements from Iraq, Turkey and the United Nations also reminded traders that a long-delayed Iraqi oil-for-food deal might get back on the rails.
But oil dealers reamained sceptical about any rapid implementation of the exchange.
